name: Scaffold Rush
author: Retro Console
description: Climb an unfinished tower while a mischievous robot rolls tyres down the girders. Jump the hazards, grab the mallet, ride lifts and belts, then pop every rivet to bring the whole structure down.

achievements.name: Top of the Tower
achievements.desc: Reach the flag on the girder screen

achievements.name: Mallet Man
achievements.desc: Smash 5 hazards with the mallet in one run

achievements.name: Leaper
achievements.desc: Jump over 10 hazards in one run

achievements.name: Tower Down
achievements.desc: Remove every rivet and topple the tower
